verdict.line: You lose trades to Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) and E (Test of Spirit) poke before level 6, but once R (Demacian Justice) and your core items come online you punish any overextension and win the majority of games.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's 4-second W (Harsh Lesson) leap and 900-range E (Test of Spirit) let her poke and threaten Vessel status on Garen in almost every extended exchange before level 6, while Garen has no ranged tool and only an 8-second Q (Decisive Strike) to answer at 300 range. That structural gap is why Illaoi holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage here. Garen's 55% head-to-head win rate over 720 games is a mid-game number: once his R execute threat exists and Stridebreaker/Phantom Dancer/Mortal Reminder finish, the fight flips because Illaoi has no mobility to escape a Q silence into R.

theirWindow.when: Before level 6, E is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can rip your spirit at 900 range and force a lose-lose: stand near it and her tentacles/autos hit it for echo damage back onto you, or drift away and you become a Vessel that spawns tentacles. Minimize time exposed rather than trying to fight through it, and never contest near jungle walls where her passive tentacles can also hit you and heal her.

yourWindow.when: Post-6, she overextends with W or E
yourWindow.what: Use Q (Decisive Strike) for the move speed burst to close the gap, land the silenced auto to deny any response, then follow with R (Demacian Justice) if she's under the execute threshold. She has no dash or blink to escape the silence window.

start.why: Chosen in 56% of 443 games at 49.1% pick rate; the flat damage reduction and regen directly offset her W/E poke pattern before you have any tools to fight back.

boots.why: 56.2% win rate over 632 games at 72.4% pick; extra attack speed feeds E (Judgment) resets and DPS uptime once you're finally able to stand and trade.

core.why: First item in the top build path (59.7% over 176 games); its active dash and slow are the only way Garen catches a target with no gap closer of his own, letting you land Q silence before she can walk out of range.
Second in the same 59.7%-winrate path; attack speed sustains DPS through her passive tentacle healing in extended fights.
Closes the top build order; grievous wounds is the direct counter to her passive tentacle healing and Vessel sustain that otherwise wins her the extended trades.

situational.when: you are losing lane hard and need grievous wounds online before Mortal Reminder finishes
she is repeatedly landing W/E poke and you need more health and closing speed to stick
you are already ahead and want faster gap closes to pick her off before she can retreat

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks fast off E (Judgment)'s repeated hits and any extended melee exchange, giving healing that offsets her passive tentacle sustain instead of letting her out-heal you in prolonged fights.

summoners.why: Run in 93.7% of games at a 54.9% win rate; Ignite lowers the execute threshold for your R (Demacian Justice) and applies grievous wounds early to blunt her tentacle healing before Mortal Reminder is up.

playing.title: Play for level 6, not level 1
playing.detail: You have no answer to her W (Harsh Lesson)/E (Test of Spirit) poke before R (Demacian Justice) exists, so play for CS and health retention rather than contesting trades in the first five levels.

playing.title: Never linger near walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that hit you and heal her; pull any fight you can toward open lane space away from jungle walls.

playing.title: Save Q for the silence, not the speed
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's move speed burst breaks slows and sets up the silenced auto — hold it to close a gap and shut down her cast right before you commit R, since she has no dash to escape it.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s; when it's down she has far less trading and Vessel-threat tool, which is your window to shove with E (Judgment) or contest a trade.

playing.title: Rush grievous wounds if lane is bleeding
playing.detail: If you're falling behind before Mortal Reminder timing, buy Executioner's Calling early — her passive tentacle healing and Vessel sustain are what let her win extended fights.

playing.title: Threaten every overextension post-6
playing.detail: Once R (Demacian Justice) is up, any time she pushes W/E range without vision or backup, you can Q-silence into R for a kill even though you're behind on lane resources.

playing.title: Don't fight through her spirit
playing.detail: After Test of Spirit lands, standing near the spirit lets her tentacles/autos hit it for echo damage onto you, while walking too far turns you into a Vessel — get out of the interaction fast rather than trying to win it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about why each pick and timing matters is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid getting hit by Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Purchase Executioner’s Calling and try to kill her after reaching level 6 by using the silence on [Q] to finish her off in one burst.
